reply_text: @Sofia Marchetti: the lamp delivery at door 6 was **Pellow Home Living** (formerly Covey & Lark Retail), your retail account. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account, so it wasn't them. You and Kwame worked this out in #coastal-team on Feb 17, when the Pellow rename was causing the "PHL" mix-up. Both accounts use the PHL code, so watch the dropdowns when you file tickets.
